questions.title: Break Statement Effect
questions.description: What does the break statement do when used inside a for or while loop?
questions.Option1: It immediately terminates the loop and resumes execution after the loop
questions.Option2: It skips the remaining statements in the current iteration only
questions.Option3: It restarts the loop from the beginning
questions.Option4: It pauses the loop until the next input is read

questions.title: Continue in for Loop
questions.description: What is the effect of continue inside a for loop?
questions.Option1: It skips the remaining statements in the current iteration and proceeds to the update step
questions.Option3: It repeats the current iteration from the start
